description: Source code for the 'Review' controller class within the OpenCart admin catalog module. The class handles listing, filtering, and managing product reviews in the admin interface.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for managing product reviews in the admin panel. Includes methods for listing reviews, filtering, and rendering the review list page, as well as the review form and delete functionalities.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for managing product reviews in the admin panel. Includes methods for listing reviews, filtering, rendering review pages, review form, save, delete, and synchronize functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the review list page with filters, breadcrumbs, and review data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of reviews in JSON or other format, utilizing internal getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of reviews from the database applying the current filters, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a review, pre-filling data if review_id is provided.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new review or updating an existing review, responding with JSON status and errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected reviews, providing JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization, e.g., updating review ratings for products, providing JSON response.
